name: recorder-backend
implemented: Added RecordingBackend protocol and FFmpegRecordingBackend implementation.
Added FFmpeg detection via PATH lookup and clear FileNotFoundError handling when missing.
Added separate command builders for 3-second test recordings and 30-second clip recordings.
Added recording target support for game-window title capture and explicit region capture.
Added desktop tests for detection, command generation, region capture arguments, and missing FFmpeg failure handling.

ffmpeg.reason: ffmpeg executable is not available in PATH

mistakes_recorded: Do not patch methods on frozen dataclass instances; patch module-level collaborators such as shutil.which.
